content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"no","applies_why":"The judge text does not rest on a single verse's silence; it says the point was answered by weighing two chains, so the rule's own scope exclusion applies.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"D6 vs C4 (Romans 1:3): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.","rule_words":"This is about one verse. It does not apply when the judge weighs two chains.","room":"weighs two chains — one reading: the cited comparison of descent according to the flesh with conception of the Holy Ghost is a two-chain weighing, so K-S2 is inapplicable; the other reading: it is still a single-verse silence point, so K-S2 applies.","why":"Because the judge text expressly grounds the UNDERDETERMINED result in weighing descent according to the flesh against conception of the Holy Ghost, K-S2's single-verse prohibition does not govern it."}
